original_question: On which chromosome is the gene that causes arthrogryposis-renal dysfunction-cholestasis syndrome located?

final_qi.question: On which chromosome is the gene that causes arthrogryposis-renal dysfunction-cholestasis syndrome located?
final_qi.long_answer: Arthrogryposis-renal dysfunction-cholestasis (ARC) syndrome is most commonly caused by loss-of-function mutations in the VPS33B gene. VPS33B is located at cytogenetic band 15q26 on human chromosome 15; pathogenic variants in this locus disrupt vesicle-mediated protein trafficking, leading to the multisystem features of ARC syndrome.
